name: Template: night-drive-launch
prompt:
Turn inputs/quest3-dark.mp4 into a director template named "night-drive-launch" with the make-template skill.

Run bin/dissect inputs/quest3-dark.mp4 --template night-drive-launch, read the boards, and write templates/night-drive-launch/ to docs/template_spec.md: TEMPLATE.md, template.json with cut30 and cut15, a board per shot and the asset set. Finish with bin/template check templates/night-drive-launch.

Then benchmark it: without opening the original footage again, remake the 30 s cut from the template alone and put the remake next to bin/template reference for a side-by-side.

Listing: publish to the marketplace. Write templates/night-drive-launch/catalog.json with goal "Product launch", tone "Sleek", cast "No cast" and the industries it fits.
